name: Resource Scarcity
description: Participants must operate under limited time, money, or information.

name: Hidden Information
description: Not all variables are known; learners must act under uncertainty.

name: Timed Iteration Cycles
description: Work occurs in rapid cycles of build → test → reflect.

name: Negotiation Economy
description: Value is created through exchange rather than fixed reward structures.

name: Constraint Transformation
description: Constraints become generative design inputs rather than limitations.

name: Asymmetric Roles
description: Different participants have unequal information or power.
